description.value: MR MIKES is a Canadian casual steakhouse chain founded in 1960, serving premium steaks, burgers, pastas, and salads in a relaxed, unpretentious atmosphere. The Dawson Creek location sits near Mile 0 of the Alaska Highway, making it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists heading into or returning from northern BC. Dine-in, takeout, and online ordering are all available, along with a daily happy hour.

address.value: 1501 Alaska Avenue, Dawson Creek, British Columbia, V1G 1Z8, Canada
